description:
Ni Modo is a brand that embraces the cultural attitude of "it is what it is". With a focus on authenticity, resilience, and a go-with-the-flow attitude, Ni Modo embraces the imperfections and complexities of life. Through our products, Ni Modo celebrates the unique experiences and perspectives, encouraging our customers to live boldly. Whether you're facing a challenge or celebrating a triumph, Ni Modo reminds you to stay true to yourself and to trust in the journey ahead.

• Product description:

Introducing the Ni Modo Hoodie, the perfect addition to your wardrobe for those who appreciate the power of "it is what it is." Made with the soft material, this hoodie features a comfortable and relaxed fit, making it perfect for all-day wear. With its eye-catching name and bold colors, this hoodie is sure to turn heads and inspire conversation. The phrase "ni modo" is prominently displayed on the front, serving as a reminder to embrace life's ups and downs with grace and resilience. Whether you're running errands or spending a night out with friends, the Ni Modo Hoodie is the ideal choice for those who value both style and substance. So why wait? Order your Ni Modo Hoodie today and join the movement of those who embrace life with open arms.


• Payment terms:

Commission-based - This means that ambassadors earn a percentage of the sales they generate. For example, if an ambassador refers a customer who purchases $100 worth of products, and the commission rate is 10%, the ambassador would earn $10.
